scopeRu: Предварительная потребность в одинаковых глухих фонарях указанной модели. Количества монтажных ресурсов требуют отдельного подтверждения. Проём, световая площадь и поверхность остекления имеют разный смысл.

unresolvedApplicationParameters.mounting_fixings_per_unit: Applicable substrate, fixing specification and approved layout; source does not prove exact count.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.flashing_consumption_m2_per_unit: Compatible roof membrane and measured detail including overlaps; roof opening area is not consumption.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.installation_hours_per_unit: Applicable labour norm or approved installation method; no guessed hours.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.lifting_shifts: Approved access/lifting arrangement and capacity; mass alone does not determine shifts.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.delivery_trips: Supplier shipment and transport capacity; net product mass excludes packing.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.inspection_hours_per_unit: Applicable inspection scope and time norm.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.vapour_connection_sets_per_unit: Applicable continuous vapour-barrier connection. BBX family shown in CFP guide; exact current-generation accessory and roof vapour layer need confirmation; do not duplicate a barrier included in LSF lining.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.thermal_connection_m3_per_unit: Actual roof build-up, compatible insulation and measured kerb junction. Manufacturer guide pages6/15 shows continuity; no universal volume is stated.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.extension_frames_per_unit: Actual roof height/build-up and specified upstand. Guide pages10-11 has different one/two ZCE arrangements; no automatic zero or universal extension count.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.membrane_termination_sets_per_unit: Compatible covering system and termination detail. ZZZ210 in CFP guide pages9/19 is a membrane securing kit, not roof anchors; exact applicability is not inferred from the opening size.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.protective_film_removal_hours: Manufacturer ISD454625 PDF2 requires protective-film removal. Applicable time and inclusion in installation labour are unconfirmed; no separate double payment.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.final_cleanup_hours: Required final cleaning boundary, packaging collection and applicable labour norm remain unconfirmed; no default hours.
unresolvedApplicationParameters.packaging_waste_service_kg: Actual packaging/film waste, suitable collection containers, loading, transport, fuel and authorised reception must be scoped together. Net product mass is not packaging waste; no transport quantity is inferred.
